01.title: Oxygen Sensor (O2) - Bank 1, Sensor 1
01.purpose: Monitor the integrity, transition response, and voltage amplitude of the pre-catalyst Oxygen Sensor on Bank 1.
01.howItIsMeasured: The ECU switches the fuel mixture between rich and lean, measuring the sensor's response times and extreme voltages.

01_01.title: O2 Sensor B1S1 - Response Time (Rich to Lean)
01_01.purpose: Evaluate how fast the primary Oxygen Sensor on Bank 1 detects a transition from a rich mixture to a lean mixture.
01_01.howItIsMeasured: The ECU abruptly reduces the injection pulse and measures the time in ms for the signal to drop from ~0.8V to ~0.2V.

01_02.title: O2 Sensor B1S1 - Response Time (Lean to Rich)
01_02.purpose: Evaluate how fast the primary Oxygen Sensor on Bank 1 detects a transition from a lean mixture to a rich mixture.
01_02.howItIsMeasured: The ECU applies an extra fuel pulse and measures the time for the voltage to rise from ~0.2V to ~0.8V.

01_03.title: O2 Sensor B1S1 - Minimum Switching Voltage
01_03.purpose: Verify if the O2 Sensor B1S1 reaches the minimum voltage level when exposed to excess oxygen.
01_03.howItIsMeasured: During deceleration fuel cut-off (Cut-off), the ECU checks if the sensor voltage drops below the validation threshold.

01_04.title: O2 Sensor B1S1 - Maximum Switching Voltage
01_04.purpose: Verify if the O2 Sensor B1S1 reaches the correct peak voltage when the mixture is rich.
01_04.howItIsMeasured: During wide-open throttle acceleration, the ECU measures if the sensor peak voltage exceeds the high-voltage threshold.

01_07.title: O2 Sensor B1S1 - Minimum Cycle Voltage
01_07.purpose: Verify the lowest absolute voltage value generated by Sensor B1S1 during the entire test cycle.
01_07.howItIsMeasured: The ECU records the lowest electrical signal emitted by the sensor in closed-loop operation.

01_08.title: O2 Sensor B1S1 - Maximum Cycle Voltage
01_08.purpose: Verify the highest absolute voltage value generated by Sensor B1S1 during the entire test cycle.
01_08.howItIsMeasured: The ECU records the highest electrical signal emitted by the sensor during normal load variations.

02.title: Oxygen Sensor (O2) - Bank 1, Sensor 2
02.purpose: Monitor the post-catalyst Oxygen Sensor on Bank 1.
02.howItIsMeasured: The ECU measures the continuous voltage of the post-catalyst sensor to verify catalyst oxygen storage.

02_01.title: O2 Sensor B1S2 - Response Time (Rich to Lean)
02_01.purpose: Check the reaction speed of Bank 1 post-catalyst sensor during rich-to-lean mixture transitions.
02_01.howItIsMeasured: Measures the voltage drop time of the secondary sensor after altering the injection pulse.

02_02.title: O2 Sensor B1S2 - Response Time (Lean to Rich)
02_02.purpose: Check the reaction speed of Bank 1 post-catalyst sensor during lean-to-rich mixture transitions.
02_02.howItIsMeasured: Measures the voltage rise time of the secondary sensor during forced enrichment.

05.title: Oxygen Sensor (O2) - Bank 2, Sensor 1
05.purpose: Monitor the primary Oxygen Sensor on Bank 2 in V6, V8, or Boxer engines.
05.howItIsMeasured: Measures switching times and peak voltages of the pre-catalyst sensor on Bank 2.

06.title: Oxygen Sensor (O2) - Bank 2, Sensor 2
06.purpose: Monitor the secondary Oxygen Sensor on Bank 2.
06.howItIsMeasured: Evaluates post-catalyst oxygen signal on the engine's secondary bank.

21.title: Catalyst - Bank 1
21.purpose: Evaluate the chemical conversion capability and oxygen storage of the Bank 1 catalyst.
21.howItIsMeasured: The ECU compares the signal fluctuation of the post-catalyst sensor with the pre-catalyst sensor. The smaller the post-sensor variation, the more efficient the catalyst.

21_01.title: Catalyst Bank 1 - Oxygen Storage Capacity (OSC)
21_01.purpose: Calculate oxygen storage and release efficiency in the Bank 1 catalyst substrate.
21_01.howItIsMeasured: The ECU induces mixture swings and integrates the time taken for the catalyst to saturate with oxygen.

22.title: Catalyst - Bank 2
22.purpose: Evaluate the efficiency of the Bank 2 catalyst in dual-bank engines.
22.howItIsMeasured: Comparison of switching frequencies between pre- and post-catalyst sensors on Bank 2.

31.title: EGR System - Bank 1
31.purpose: Verify that exhaust gas recirculation flow on Bank 1 is correct and unobstructed.
31.howItIsMeasured: The ECU opens the EGR valve during deceleration and monitors manifold vacuum change.

31_01.title: EGR System Bank 1 - Gas Flow Rate
31_01.purpose: Measure the effective exhaust gas flow rate admitted by the EGR system on Bank 1.
31_01.howItIsMeasured: The ECU checks absolute manifold pressure increase when energizing the EGR.

35.title: Variable Valve Timing (VVT) - Bank 1
35.purpose: Monitor accuracy and response time of Bank 1 camshaft phase timing variation.
35.howItIsMeasured: The ECU sends commands to the VVT solenoid and measures camshaft angle displacement.

35_01.title: VVT System Bank 1 - Phase Position Error
35_01.purpose: Measure deviation between ECU commanded phase angle and actual Bank 1 camshaft position.
35_01.howItIsMeasured: Measures angular difference in degrees between camshaft phase sensor signal and crankshaft reluctor wheel.

39.title: EVAP - General Tank Monitor
39.purpose: Check tightness and integrity of fuel tank and charcoal canister.
39.howItIsMeasured: The ECU inspects pressure variations in the tank under normal driving conditions.

39_31.title: EVAP - Purge Rate and Leakage
39_31.purpose: Evaluate fuel vapor purge flow into the intake manifold.
39_31.howItIsMeasured: Measures short-term fuel trim (STFT) variation caused by vapor combustion.

3A.title: EVAP - Tightness / Initial Vacuum
3A.purpose: Validate primary sealing of canister valves prior to leak testing.
3A.howItIsMeasured: Seals the fuel system and checks natural stabilization of vapor pressure.

3A_C0.title: EVAP - Initial Tank Pressure Stability
3A_C0.purpose: Confirm internal tank pressure is stable prior to vacuum testing.
3A_C0.howItIsMeasured: Monitors pressure fluctuations caused by fuel sloshing in the tank for a short period.

3A_C1.title: EVAP - Residual Vacuum Retention in Canister
3A_C1.purpose: Verify charcoal canister holds vacuum without connection leaks.
3A_C1.howItIsMeasured: Measures decay of residual vacuum accumulated in the canister.

3B.title: EVAP - Gross Leak Test (0.090")
3B.purpose: Detect severe leaks, open gas cap, or ruptured hoses.
3B.howItIsMeasured: The ECU seals the system and opens purge. If no vacuum builds, the test fails.

3B_CA.title: EVAP - Vacuum Retention Under Load (Gross Leak)
3B_CA.purpose: Validate that generated vacuum holds during engine load changes.
3B_CA.howItIsMeasured: Applies vacuum and monitors rapid pressure loss under light acceleration.

3C.title: EVAP - Medium Leak Test (0.040")
3C.purpose: Detect medium leaks in hoses, orifices, or tank seals.
3C.howItIsMeasured: Induces controlled vacuum and measures vacuum decay rate over 15 seconds.

3C_C8.title: EVAP - Vacuum Decay (0.040" Medium Leak)
3C_C8.purpose: Calculate vacuum decay slope in fuel tank line.
3C_C8.howItIsMeasured: The ECU records vapor pressure curve rate of change in Pa/s.

3C_C9.title: EVAP - Evaporative Pressure Variation
3C_C9.purpose: Distinguish leak vacuum loss from natural gasoline vapor pressure buildup.
3C_C9.howItIsMeasured: Compares pressure rise rate before and after vacuum application.

3D.title: EVAP - Micro Leak Test (0.020")
3D.purpose: Identify microscopic leaks up to 0.5mm in tank structure and piping.
3D.howItIsMeasured: Usually run via EONV (Engine Off Natural Vacuum) with engine off.

3E.title: EVAP - Canister Purge Valve
3E.purpose: Test electrical actuation and mechanical sealing of purge valve.
3E.howItIsMeasured: Applies PWM pulses and measures intake manifold vacuum response.

3E_C5.title: EVAP - Purge Solenoid Response Time
3E_C5.purpose: Measure opening agility of purge solenoid when commanded.
3E_C5.howItIsMeasured: Measures delay between electric pulse sent and manifold vacuum change.

3F.title: EVAP - Ventilation Valve (Vent Valve)
3F.purpose: Test if Vent Valve closes completely under electrical command.
3F.howItIsMeasured: Energizes valve and monitors isolation from atmospheric pressure.

3F_C4.title: EVAP - Vent Valve Flow and Blockage
3F_C4.purpose: Verify vent valve is unobstructed in de-energized state.
3F_C4.howItIsMeasured: Measures equalization time between tank pressure and ambient air.

41.title: Oxygen Sensor Heater - Bank 1, Sensor 1
41.purpose: Monitor the resistance and integrity of the pre-catalyst sensor heater on Bank 1.
41.howItIsMeasured: The ECU measures current draw and voltage drop across the heater circuit.

41_03.title: O2 Sensor B1S1 Heater - Circuit Resistance/Current
41_03.purpose: Verify the integrity of the internal heating resistor of Sensor B1S1.
41_03.howItIsMeasured: The ECU monitors current consumption in Amperes during cold start.

42.title: Oxygen Sensor Heater - Bank 1, Sensor 2
42.purpose: Monitor the post-catalyst sensor heater on Bank 1.
42.howItIsMeasured: Measures electrical current consumption of the post-catalyst heating resistor.

71.title: Secondary Air System - Bank 1
71.purpose: Monitor fresh air injection into the exhaust during cold start.
71.howItIsMeasured: Verifies if O2 Sensor B1S1 registers a voltage drop indicating excess air when turning on the pump.

71_01.title: Secondary Air System Bank 1 - Air Flow
71_01.purpose: Measure the volume of secondary air injected into the exhaust manifold.
71_01.howItIsMeasured: Measures the leaning rate of the oxygen sensor reading during pump operation.

81.title: Fuel System - Bank 1
81.purpose: Evaluate adjustment limits and balance of Bank 1 fuel delivery system.
81.howItIsMeasured: Monitors the sum of short-term and long-term adaptive fuel trims (STFT + LTFT).

81_01.title: Fuel System Bank 1 - Upper Correction Limit
81_01.purpose: Verify if the ECU reached the maximum fuel enrichment limit.
81_01.howItIsMeasured: The ECU evaluates if the sum of fuel trims exceeds +25% without enriching the mixture.

91.title: Boost Pressure (Turbo) - Bank 1
91.purpose: Monitor pressure control and limits exerted by the turbocharger on Bank 1.
91.howItIsMeasured: Compares boost pressure measured in intake manifold with target boost requested.

91_01.title: Boost Pressure Bank 1 - Overboost/Underboost Error
91_01.purpose: Detect turbo pressure deviations (overboost or underboost).
91_01.howItIsMeasured: Subtracts measured absolute pressure from commanded pressure under full load.

A1.title: General Misfire - Engine Summary
A1.purpose: Ensure consolidated misfire count across all cylinders.
A1.howItIsMeasured: Continuous monitoring of crankshaft rotation variations.

A1_0B.title: General Misfire - Exponential Weighted Moving Average (EWMA)
A1_0B.purpose: Evaluate historical average rate of misfires across all cylinders over the last 1,000 to 10,000 cycles.
A1_0B.howItIsMeasured: EWMA digital filter applied over reluctor wheel pulses to isolate systematic ignition deviations.

A1_0C.title: General Misfire - Current Cycle Count
A1_0C.purpose: Count absolute total misfires occurring across the engine during current drive cycle.
A1_0C.howItIsMeasured: Real-time summation of crankshaft angular acceleration loss during current engine run.

A2.title: Misfire - Cylinder 1
A2.purpose: Detect specific combustion power loss on Cylinder 1.
A2.howItIsMeasured: Measures reluctor wheel angular acceleration during Cylinder 1 power stroke.

A2_0B.title: Cylinder 1 Misfire - Moving Average (EWMA)
A2_0B.purpose: Evaluate historical trend and accumulated combustion wear on Cylinder 1.
A2_0B.howItIsMeasured: Long EWMA filter focused on Cylinder 1 power stroke window.

A2_0C.title: Cylinder 1 Misfire - Current Cycle
A2_0C.purpose: Count exact number of misfires on Cylinder 1 during current trip.
A2_0C.howItIsMeasured: Instantaneous count of crankshaft torque loss events associated with Cylinder 1.

A3.title: Misfire - Cylinder 2
A3.purpose: Detect specific combustion power loss on Cylinder 2.
A3.howItIsMeasured: Measures crankshaft angular acceleration during Cylinder 2 expansion stroke.

A3_0B.title: Cylinder 2 Misfire - Moving Average (EWMA)
A3_0B.purpose: Evaluate historical misfire trend on Cylinder 2.
A3_0B.howItIsMeasured: Weighted moving average of crankshaft acceleration on Cylinder 2.

A3_0C.title: Cylinder 2 Misfire - Current Cycle
A3_0C.purpose: Count misfires on Cylinder 2 during this drive cycle.
A3_0C.howItIsMeasured: Immediate measurement of deceleration on reluctor wheel during Cylinder 2 firing time.

A4.title: Misfire - Cylinder 3
A4.purpose: Detect specific combustion power loss on Cylinder 3.
A4.howItIsMeasured: Measures crankshaft rotation pulse referring to Cylinder 3.

A4_0B.title: Cylinder 3 Misfire - Moving Average (EWMA)
A4_0B.purpose: Evaluate historical misfire trend on Cylinder 3.
A4_0B.howItIsMeasured: Long EWMA filter focused on Cylinder 3.

A4_0C.title: Cylinder 3 Misfire - Current Cycle
A4_0C.purpose: Count misfires on Cylinder 3 in current trip.
A4_0C.howItIsMeasured: Direct count of torque loss during Cylinder 3 firing interval.

A5.title: Misfire - Cylinder 4
A5.purpose: Detect specific combustion power loss on Cylinder 4.
A5.howItIsMeasured: Measures Cylinder 4 piston stroke acceleration on reluctor wheel.

A5_0B.title: Cylinder 4 Misfire - Moving Average (EWMA)
A5_0B.purpose: Evaluate historical misfire trend on Cylinder 4.
A5_0B.howItIsMeasured: Accumulated EWMA filter focused on Cylinder 4.

A5_0C.title: Cylinder 4 Misfire - Current Cycle
A5_0C.purpose: Count misfires on Cylinder 4 in current drive cycle.
A5_0C.howItIsMeasured: Instantaneous measurement of power loss on Cylinder 4.

A6.title: Misfire - Cylinder 5
A6.howItIsMeasured: Measurement of reluctor wheel deceleration on Cylinder 5 expansion.

A6_0B.title: Cylinder 5 Misfire - Moving Average (EWMA)
A6_0B.purpose: Evaluate historical misfire trend on Cylinder 5.

A6_0C.title: Cylinder 5 Misfire - Current Cycle
A6_0C.purpose: Count misfires on Cylinder 5 in current trip.
A6_0C.howItIsMeasured: Instantaneous count of power loss events on Cylinder 5.

A7.title: Misfire - Cylinder 6
A7.howItIsMeasured: Measurement of crankshaft angular acceleration on Cylinder 6.

A7_0B.title: Cylinder 6 Misfire - Moving Average (EWMA)
A7_0B.purpose: Evaluate historical misfire trend on Cylinder 6.

A7_0C.title: Cylinder 6 Misfire - Current Cycle
A7_0C.purpose: Count misfires on Cylinder 6 in current drive cycle.
A7_0C.howItIsMeasured: Count of instantaneous misfire events on Cylinder 6.

A8.title: Misfire - Cylinder 7
A8.howItIsMeasured: Analysis of crankshaft acceleration on Cylinder 7.

A8_0B.title: Cylinder 7 Misfire - Moving Average (EWMA)
A8_0B.purpose: Evaluate historical misfire trend on Cylinder 7.

A8_0C.title: Cylinder 7 Misfire - Current Cycle
A8_0C.purpose: Count misfires on Cylinder 7 in current trip.
A8_0C.howItIsMeasured: Instantaneous count of misfires on Cylinder 7.

A9.title: Misfire - Cylinder 8
A9.howItIsMeasured: Analysis of crankshaft acceleration on Cylinder 8.

A9_0B.title: Cylinder 8 Misfire - Moving Average (EWMA)
A9_0B.purpose: Evaluate historical misfire trend on Cylinder 8.

A9_0C.title: Cylinder 8 Misfire - Current Cycle
A9_0C.purpose: Count misfires on Cylinder 8 in current trip.
A9_0C.howItIsMeasured: Count of instantaneous misfires on Cylinder 8.

B0.title: Consolidated Misfire - All Cylinders
B0.purpose: Present unified misfire count across all engine cylinders.
B0.howItIsMeasured: Real-time summation of all acceleration losses recorded on reluctor wheel.

B0_0B.title: Consolidated Misfire - Moving Average (EWMA)
B0_0B.purpose: Monitor historical accumulated average misfire rate combining all cylinders.
B0_0B.howItIsMeasured: Consolidated EWMA calculation for all cylinders.

B0_0C.title: Consolidated Misfire - Current Cycle
B0_0C.purpose: Count total accumulated misfires across all cylinders during this drive.
B0_0C.howItIsMeasured: Continuous sum of identified misfires across all cylinders during current run.

B2.title: Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) - Filter Efficiency
B2.purpose: Monitor soot retention and DPF filter efficiency in Diesel engines.
B2.howItIsMeasured: The ECU measures backpressure before and after the DPF ceramic element.

B2_01.title: DPF Filter - Restriction Differential Pressure
B2_01.purpose: Measure soot clogging level of the DPF filter.
B2_01.howItIsMeasured: Measures pressure variation in kPa across the filter element to determine regeneration need.

B3.title: Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR / NOx) Catalyst
B3.purpose: Monitor nitrogen oxide conversion efficiency via urea (DEF / AdBlue) injection.
B3.howItIsMeasured: Compares NOx concentration in ppm at SCR system inlet and outlet.
